observations.finding: Treated fields markedly less confluent than DMSO (f_ad322e23a39f). Control shows large coherent epithelial sheet covering >50% of field; treated fields show fragmentation into small islands (5-15 cells) and many isolated cells, more black background.

Bright rounded yellow (green+red colocalization) cells with condensed blue DNA - mitotic-like/detached - increased in treated vs control. Control: 1-2 per field. Treated: f_d895c52d8595 4-5 (top hourglass, top right, center), f_36cefc6cf5bc 3-4 (center, top), f_97117b6cf921 and f_15134fd3aeec 2-3 per field.
Increased mitotic index/mitotic arrest visible as rounded cells with intense diffuse tubulin and actin colocalization. This phenotype is not represented in top_deviations.

Tubulin (green) filamentous network less clearly spread in treated; many interphase cells appear more contracted/stellate with prominent peripheral actin, versus control flat spread morphology with radiating green tubulin. No tubulin intensity/bundling feature in top_deviations to confirm.

Actin (red) intensity appears higher in treated: more saturated red at cell periphery, cortical belts and spiky retraction/stellate protrusions at colony edges, versus control more uniform thin cortical red. Consistent with identical contrast settings implying true increase.

Actin pattern more heterogeneous/variable cell-to-cell in treated, with patchy bright red and high local contrast between protrusions and cell body, versus control even red staining. Consistent with increased actin variance/contrast.

Nuclei (blue) on average smaller, more compact than control oval ~36px major axis. Control uniform ovoid nuclei; treated many nuclei reduced area, consistent with population mean shift despite identical contrast.

Nuclear shape more irregular in treated: more lobed, indented or elongated contours, loss of smooth ovoid/roundness. In control nuclei smooth and round; treated show increased irregularity/concavities seen as reduced form-factor/solidity.

Subpopulation of enlarged/bilobed/multinucleated nuclei among smaller nuclei in treated (e.g., f_97117b6cf921 centre-bottom, f_15134fd3aeec centre, f_d895c52d8595 top) versus rare in control. Consistent with elevated fraction of large nuclei despite overall mean area decrease - bimodal size distribution.

notable_cells.why: hourglass constricted doublet with 2 yellow-intense condensed nuclei - putative failed cytokinesis/mitotic arrest, markedly higher tubulin+actin intensity vs control interphase cells
isolated intensely yellow rounded cell with diffuse tubulin/actin and pale condensed DNA - typical mitotic/arrested cell increased vs DMSO

candidate_mechanisms.why: most compatible with combination of strong reduction in nuc_form_factor z -20.8 and nuc_solidity z -13.0, increased frac_large_nucleus z 5.6 with overall reduced nuc_area, plus visibly increased bright rounded mitotic-like cells and actin remodelling. Aurora phenotype classically produces irregular, multilobed/polyploid nuclei and mitotic delay. act_mean/act_std/act_glcm_contrast elevation also matches this class secondary cytoskeletal changes.

composites alone without grayscale tubulin/actin separation cannot definitively distinguish Aurora vs Eg5 inhibitors vs Microtubule destabilizers/stabilizers which also produce mitotic arrest and nuclear irregularity. Tubulin bundling/loss or monopolar spindles not evaluable at this resolution. Conservative call is unknown/mitotic inhibitor, Aurora best differential.

report.uncertainty: Only composites provided, 1024x819 px; green (tubulin) vs red (actin) overlap appears yellow, limiting assessment of microtubule filament loss versus bundling. Visual appraisal qualitative. Microtubule-targeting and Eg5 inhibitors remain in differential for rounded mitotic accumulation.

reflection.text:
Post-unblinding reflection - PP-2, PubChem CID 4878 / ChEMBL CHEMBL406845, truth MoA Epithelial. Protocol and Scientist both called Epithelial, scored correct. Review verdict approve.

What the blinded evidence got right:

Acquisition strategy sampled dose-dependence, not single-well artefact. I started with list_available_experiments: 8 doses 0.01-30 uM, 4/4 wells. I chose w_83f5e5592a at 1 uM and w_2c56be780a at 10 uM first - mid and high - to see emergence. Both gave extreme nuclear shape changes: nuc_form_factor z=-8.8 at 1 uM to z=-20.9 at 10 uM, nuc_solidity z=-3.0 to -13.0, act_glcm_contrast z=+9.8 at 10 uM. I then bridged with w_12aa18d253 at 3 uM (form_factor z=-14.5, solidity -6.0, contrast +5.0) and tested maximum with w_13e24cb3fd at 30 uM (form_factor z=-33.7, solidity -26.0, contrast +28.0). Cell counts remained interpretable (170, 362, 353, 167 cells) - countable, segmented, not a toxic washout.

The quantitative dose_response over those 4 wells was the strongest argument: nuc_form_factor rho=-1.00 p=0, act_glcm_contrast rho=+1.00 p=0, frac_mitotic_like rho=+1.00 p=0. Monotonic across independent doses argues for a specific scattering/fragmentation signature, not random well effect. Critically, the review note that mitotic fraction only rose at high dose (z -1.3 to +11.3) while nuclear irregularity was already strong at 1-3 uM without mitotic accumulation indicates nuclear/cytoskeletal disruption precedes secondary high-dose arrest. That pattern argues against primary Aurora/Eg5-like mitotic arrest, even though describe_phenotype on 4 fields listed Aurora kinase inhibitors as a candidate visual impression. I correctly down-weighted that visual candidate.

Comparison to reference atlas was consistent and replicated: first compare_to_reference_atlas over 2 wells: Epithelial 2/2 NSC, 6/10 k-neighbours Epithelial; second over 4 wells: Epithelial 3/4 NSC, 6/10 k-neighbours Epithelial, mean similarity 0.65. Per-well protocol table confirms this: 1 uM 0.246 Epithelial, 3 uM 0.528 Epithelial, 10 uM 0.798 Epithelial, only 30 uM dissenting to Protein synthesis 0.648. That 3/4 majority with high similarity at 10 uM outweighs a single extreme dose.

What misled / what I missed:

The 30 uM well was genuinely misleading: nearest MoA Protein synthesis, similarity 0.648, with extreme values (form_factor -33.7, solidity -26.0, contrast +28.0) and lowest cell count 167. In hypothesis history I put Protein synthesis 0.15 supporting_ids e7,e8 contradicting e4, which was correct to retain as alternative. I did not acquire wells below 1 uM (0.01-0.3 uM) to define a no-effect threshold, nor replicate low doses. With only 4 wells acquired I could not test whether the Protein synthesis signal at 30 uM reflects non-specific cytotoxicity at top dose vs a true secondary MoA. The 0.68 probability for Epithelial appropriately reflected that discordant well, as review noted.

I also had no curated mechanism to anchor on pre-unblinding: lookup_compound after submit showed CHEMBL mechanisms none curated, though identity check name and BBBC021 structure agree, so I could not validate pharmacology blinded. Post-unblinding search_literature PubMed 'PP2 Src kinase inhibitor epithelial' 184 hits, 5 returned, provides context that was missing blinded: PP-2 is a c-Src/Src-family inhibitor with documented epithelial effects - regulation of epithelial-mesenchymal transition PMID 36527337, acceleration of differentiation in human intestinal epithelial cells PMID 23274493, blocking TGF-beta1-mediated cellular responses via TGF-beta receptors PMID 21395548 and TGF-beta1-induced migration/invasion PMID 22699812, and C-Src-dependent epithelial barrier regulation PMID 30007960. Those papers were not available during the blinded call; the second search on MCF-7 phenotypic profiling returned 0 hits. This supports that the atlas label Epithelial is a phenotypic proxy for Src-related actin/adherens junction effects, not a detailed kinase annotation, but I had to infer it purely from morphology.

Why final call held: protocol 1-NN per acquired well majority vote (Ljosa et al. 2013) gave Epithelial 3 votes summed similarity 1.572 vs Protein synthesis 1 vote 0.648. My scientist call Epithelial p=0.68 mirrored protocol, with dose-response monotonicity and atlas replication as key_evidence_ids e4,e8,e3,e5,e9,e10,e11. The extreme 30 uM phenotype did not overturn the convergent low-mid dose signal.

Lesson: extreme top dose can pull nearest neighbor to Protein synthesis even when underlying trajectory is Epithelial scattering; bridging doses 1-10 uM and checking mitotic fraction dose separation was essential to distinguish primary nuclear shape/actin heterogeneity from secondary mitotic accumulation. Next experiment if real lab remains as stated: E-cadherin/beta-catenin and phospho-FAK staining plus scratch wound motility vs reference Epithelial compound, with parallel cell cycle profile.
